parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries no populated `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, `shared_ancestor`) are null. Without field-level data for `Announcement.CodingKeys` and `ShowMarker.CodingKeys`, there is no grounded evidence that the two nested enums share members beyond what is structurally expected of any pair of `CodingKeys` enums (both conforming to `CodingKey`/`String`). The subset-pairs signal alone, absent concrete shared-field evidence, is insufficient to recommend a refactor; the coincidence of shape is a routine artefact of Swift's `Codable` synthesis pattern applied to two unrelated domain types (`Announcement` and `ShowMarker`) in the same package.
